note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 18 November 2026, RealHunt lists 32 homes for sale in Japan, each one checked by a person.
In Japan, the median asking price of those 32 homes is €43,240 (€398 per m², from the 16 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €7,400 and the most expensive €91,080.
Taxes and fees add about 6–9% to the price of a home in Japan (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: The buyer pays an agent fee capped at 3% plus ¥60,000 plus 10% consumption tax (with a special cap of up to ¥330,000 including tax for cheap vacant homes up to ¥8 million), registration tax of 1.5% on land (until March 2029) and 2% standard on the building, real estate acquisition tax of 3% of assessed value, stamp duty, and a judicial scrivener fee of about ¥100,000 to ¥200,000.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes. Foreigners can buy freehold land and homes on the same terms as Japanese citizens, even on a tourist visa, though buying does not give a visa or residency.
buying.annual_property_tax: Fixed asset tax is 1.4% of the government's assessed value, plus city planning tax of up to 0.3% in urban areas, and small residential plots get a lower tax base.
buying.rental_income_tax: Rent paid to a non-resident is subject to 20.42% withholding (except when an individual rents it as their own home), and the owner must file a tax return each year through a tax representative in Japan to settle the final tax.

homes.title: Mountain chalet with a wood stove and a loft in the Hida forest
homes.title_es: Chalet de montaña con estufa de leña y altillo en el bosque de Hida
homes.summary: A 1992 two-storey chalet of 93 m² on a 558 m² freehold plot in a managed holiday-home estate in Shokawa, Takayama (Gifu). Double-height living room with a wood stove and an open loft, fitted kitchen, a tatami bedroom, and it is sold with what is inside. Estate fee about ¥11,000 a month. Asking ¥1.3 million, about €7,400.

homes.title: Mountain cabin with hot-spring water on tap, a big deck and a far sea view in Izu
homes.title_es: Cabaña de montaña con agua de aguas termales en el grifo, una gran plataforma y vistas lejanas al mar en Izu
homes.summary: A single-storey 1982 cabin of 66 m² on a 1,587 m² freehold plot at 880 m in the Amagi Kogen woods above Ito, on the Izu peninsula. Wood-lined living room with a stove, a sunroom and a wide wooden deck looking through the trees to Mount Komuro and the sea. Hot-spring water is already piped into the house (about ¥9,100 a month). Asking ¥1.8 million, about €10,200.

homes.title: Furnished log cabin on stilts with a deck in the Hida forest
homes.title_es: Cabaña de troncos amueblada sobre pilotes con terraza en el bosque de Hida
homes.summary: A 1999 log cabin of 53 m² on a 332 m² freehold plot in a managed forest estate in Shokawa, Takayama. Open living room under a loft, log-walled kitchen and bathroom, and a wooden deck in the trees. Sold furnished with appliances, water included in the estate fee of about ¥11,000 a month. Asking ¥2 million, about €11,400.

homes.title: Ready-to-live forest villa with two balconies near Lake Misasa, Nagano
homes.title_es: Villa forestal lista para vivir con dos balcones cerca del lago Misasa, Nagano
homes.summary: A 1991 villa of 106 m² with 3 rooms on a 897 m² freehold plot in the Misasa holiday estate, 330 m from Lake Misasa and 25 minutes by car from Sakudaira bullet-train station. Bright living room opening onto a balcony in the larches, two floors that work as separate units. Ready to move in; estate fee ¥12,000 a year for residents. Asking ¥2.8 million, about €15,900.

homes.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom house in Gifu with a brand-new kitchen
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios completamente renovada en Gifu con cocina nueva de fábrica
homes.summary: A 69 m² house with 3 bedrooms and a 20 m² living-dining room on a 127 m² freehold plot in Akutami, Gifu city. Fully renovated in 2024: new kitchen, toilet and vanity, new floors and walls, plus free parking. Ready to move in. Asking ¥3.3 million, about €18,800.

homes.title: Wood-lined holiday home in a seaside estate with a pool and tennis courts, Wakayama
homes.title_es: Casa de vacaciones forrada de madera en una urbanización costera con piscina y pistas de tenis, Wakayama
homes.summary: A 1996 two-storey holiday home of 70 m² in the Kinosato estate in Inami, Wakayama, popular with sea anglers. Wood-lined living-kitchen with big windows over the hills, a tatami room, and parking. The estate pool and tennis courts are 70 m away and the coast is a short drive. Asking ¥3.5 million, about €19,900.

homes.title: Cedar-lined forest cabin renovated in 2023, with a deck and a big loft room
homes.title_es: Cabaña forestal revestida de cedro renovada en 2023, con una plataforma y una gran habitación de altillo
homes.summary: A 2004 cabin of 75 m² on a 165 m² freehold plot in a forest holiday village in Agano, Niigata. Cedar walls throughout, 3 rooms plus a 20-tatami loft room, a wooden deck and parking. Renovated in December 2023; hot spring water can be connected as an option. Asking ¥4 million, about €22,800.

homes.title: Wooden villa in Kita-Karuizawa that you can rent out as a holiday home
homes.title_es: Villa de madera en Kita-Karuizawa que puede alquilarse como casa de vacaciones
homes.summary: A single-storey 1990 villa of 60 m² on a 410 m² freehold plot in a well-kept estate in Kita-Karuizawa, Gunma. Wood-lined living room opening onto a balcony in the trees, two tatami rooms, fitted kitchen. Listed as usable for holiday lets. Estate fee about ¥58,000 a year. Asking ¥4.5 million, about €25,600.

homes.title: Bungalow 3 minutes' walk from the beach in Wakayama, new facade in 2025
homes.title_es: Bungalow a 3 minutos a pie de la playa en Wakayama, fachada nueva en 2025
homes.summary: A 2000 steel-frame bungalow of 59 m² with 3 rooms on a 116 m² freehold plot, a 3-minute walk from Kirime beach and 1 km from the station. New exterior cladding in May 2025, sunsets over the sea, good fishing. The 50 m² plot next door can also be bought. Asking ¥4.8 million, about €27,300.

homes.title: Renovated two-storey villa in the Mount Akagi woods, Gunma
homes.title_es: Villa de dos plantas renovada en el bosque del Monte Akagi, Gunma
homes.summary: A 1996 villa of 70 m² on a 302 m² freehold plot on the lower slopes of Mount Akagi, Maebashi. Renovated: bright living-kitchen, tatami room and a bedroom upstairs, parking. Golf courses, a campsite and hot springs nearby. Estate fee about ¥48,000 a year including water. Asking ¥4.9 million, about €27,900.

homes.title: Japanese home with a sakura garden
homes.title_es: Casa japonesa con jardín de sakura
homes.summary: Built in 1977, this charming single-storey wooden home features a spacious 6DK layout with five Japanese-style rooms and one Western bedroom, providing 141㎡ of living space on a generous 430㎡ lot.

homes.title: Tiny hillside house above the sea, two minutes from the beach
homes.title_es: Casita en la ladera sobre el mar, a dos minutos de la playa
homes.summary: A tiny house on a hillside in Yura, Wakayama, 80 meters above the sea, for $20,000. Yura is a coastal town of about 5,000 people on the Kii Peninsula; Osaka is roughly two hours by express train and the nearest station an 11-minute drive. Two beaches are within a two-minute drive and a sea fishing park is three.

homes.title: Single-storey Japanese house in a seaside town
homes.title_es: Casa japonesa de una planta en un pueblo costero
homes.summary: Located in northern Wakayama Prefecture, Kainan is a charming seaside town, a 15-minute train ride from central Wakayama City. It is surrounded by rolling hills and rugged mountains and is known for its production of Kishu lacquerware and sea salt.

homes.title: 100-year-old farmhouse with farmland and a storehouse
homes.title_es: Casa de labranza de 100 años con tierras de cultivo y almacén
homes.summary: I honestly cannot believe a 100-year-old traditional home with its own farmland and storehouse is sitting here for under $20,000. This property gives you nearly 1,000 square meters of land and a 120-square-meter, 8-room house.

homes.title: Single-storey house with a huge lawn on the Seto Inland Sea
homes.title_es: Casa de una planta con un césped enorme junto al mar interior de Seto
homes.summary: $47,000 for a single-story old house in Kagawa with a lawn bigger than most people's entire lot. This one's in Mitoyo, on the Shonai peninsula sticking out into the Seto Inland Sea.

homes.title: Traditional house with ocean views on the Kyoto coast
homes.title_es: Casa tradicional con vistas al mar en la costa de Kioto
homes.summary: An Amazing and Cheap Traditional Japanese House in Kyoto for Sale, with Ocean Views for Just $54K USD! Nestled in the peaceful coastal area of Kyoto prefecture, this charming property combines authentic character with modern comfort. Built in 1940, this spacious 6DK home offers 152 m² of living space.

homes.title: Hillside kominka with sea views over the Kyoto coast
homes.title_es: Kominka en la ladera con vistas al mar sobre la costa de Kyoto
homes.summary: Imagine sipping your morning coffee on the engawa (wooden veranda), the Sea of Japan spread out below you, in a proper old kominka for under $60k. This one sits high on a hillside in Maizuru, up on the Kyoto coast, a couple hours from Kyoto city itself.

homes.title: White log cabin with a big deck in a lake community
homes.title_es: Cabaña de troncos blanca con una gran terraza de madera en una urbanización junto a un lago
homes.summary: A white log cabin tucked into a wooded resort town in Hyogo, with a big deck that already has a sink plumbed in for barbecues. It sits in a quiet lake community in the hills above Himeji, about two hours from Osaka by car. Around it are trees and a slope of forest land, with room beside it for two cars and a garden.

homes.title: Freshly renovated five-bedroom house with an ocean view
homes.title_es: Casa de cinco dormitorios recién reformada con vistas al mar
homes.summary: An ocean view, five bedrooms and a kitchen installed last month, all for $61,000 (¥9.8 million). The house is in Arahama, a small coastal neighborhood of Kashiwazaki on the Sea of Japan side, about two and a half hours from Tokyo. Bus stop three minutes on foot, train station 28.

homes.title: Renovated hilltop house with panoramic sea views
homes.title_es: Casa reformada en lo alto de una colina con vistas panorámicas al mar
homes.summary: This 2-story hilltop house with panoramic views of the sea can be found in Bizen, Okayama for $62,000 USD. Although this property was constructed in the early-1990s, it was renovated both inside and out a few years ago with new flooring, tatami mats, toilet, sink, and more, so it is currently in move-in condition.

homes.title: Renovated island house with one of Japan's best sea views
homes.title_es: Casa reformada en una isla con una de las mejores vistas al mar de Japón
homes.summary: Perched on a hilltop on Kojima Island in Okayama, this beautifully renovated 2-bedroom retreat was built in 1993 and offers 91㎡ of bright living space surrounded by endless views of the Seto Inland Sea.

homes.title: Japanese villa with a stream, deck and hot spring access
homes.title_es: Villa japonesa con arroyo, terraza de madera y acceso a aguas termales
homes.summary: The 1LDK home offers 58㎡ of living space on 265㎡ of freehold land, with one bedroom, an open living and dining area, a wooden deck, and an airy atrium that makes the compact interior feel bright and welcoming.

homes.title: Fully renovated single-storey house near the coast
homes.title_es: Casa de una planta totalmente reformada cerca de la costa
homes.summary: Arida is a coastal town filled with fragrant mandarin orange groves, a 1.5-hour drive from Osaka City. It is well-known for its fresh seafood and premium mandarin oranges, which have been grown there for over 450 years !

homes.title: Authentic 150-year-old Japanese house with garden, bamboo hill and kura
homes.title_es: Auténtica casa japonesa de 150 años con jardín, colina de bambú y kura
homes.summary: An authentic 150-year-old Japanese house for just $85,000 in Echizen, Fukui, inland from the Sea of Japan. A supermarket and a big home center are a 12-minute walk away. The main house is single story, just over 230 m², laid out in the old four-room grid.

homes.title: Wooden house with a private beachfront
homes.title_es: Casa de madera con playa privada
homes.summary: This Cute Private House in Japan Comes with a Private Beachfront for Just $61K Along the peaceful coastline of Wakayama, this charming 5DK wooden home offers an affordable opportunity to embrace a slower, nature-filled lifestyle.

homes.title: Renovated family home with a view of Mount Fuji
homes.title_es: Casa familiar reformada con vistas al monte Fuji
homes.summary: Built in 2001 and renovated inside and out: 3 bedrooms plus a storage room in 87.6 m², on a 199 m² plot in Fuji city, Shizuoka, with Mount Fuji visible from the first floor. Parking for three cars. Asking price ¥11,800,000. That is about €66,700. Foreigners can buy homes in Japan with no restrictions.

homes.title: Misawa-built family house with a partial sea view on Awaji Island, Hyogo
homes.title_es: Casa familiar construida por Misawa con vista parcial al mar en la isla de Awaji, Hyogo
homes.summary: Built in October 2000 by Misawa Homes and, according to the agent, carefully used inside. 91 m² with three bedrooms, a living room of over 15 tatami and a wooden deck in the garden, on a 152 m² freehold plot in a holiday-home area of Fukakusa on Awaji Island. The outer walls and roof were redone in 2015. Part of the sea can be seen from the upper floor and Shintoshi bathing beach is about 3.8 km away. Immediate handover. Asking ¥9,500,000 (about €54,300), around €600/m².

homes.title: Nine-room 1960s farmhouse with an earthen kura near Lake Biwa
homes.title_es: Casa de campo de los años 60 con nueve habitaciones y un kura de barro cerca del lago Biwa
homes.summary: A 1960s farmhouse in Kurotani, Takashima, Shiga, with nine rooms, a mud-walled storehouse and about a quarter acre of land, for $68,000 (¥10.8 million).

homes.title: 2012 house with 4 bedrooms, renovated, near the coast in Shizuoka
homes.title_es: Casa de 2012 con 4 dormitorios, reformada, cerca de la costa de Shizuoka
homes.summary: Only 14 years old and renovated: a 4-bedroom house of 91.5 m² on a 122 m² plot in Shimizu, Shizuoka, with a fitted kitchen, a new bathroom and a tatami room. A short bus ride to JR Okitsu station on the coast. Asking price ¥14,500,000. That is about €81,900. Foreigners can buy homes in Japan with no restrictions.

homes.title: Japanese-style home with an engawa and garden in a hot spring town
homes.title_es: Casa de estilo japonés con engawa y jardín en una ciudad de aguas termales
homes.summary: A pure Japanese-style single-story home with a wide engawa opening onto its own garden, in one of Japan's most famous hot spring towns, about 90 minutes from Tokyo. This one's in Yugawara, Kanagawa, a coastal onsen town people have escaped to for a century.

homes.title: House built in 2018 on a 1,181 m² plot near the sea in Shima, Mie
homes.title_es: Casa construida en 2018 en una parcela de 1.181 m² cerca del mar en Shima, Mie
homes.summary: A two-storey wooden house finished in January 2018, far newer than most homes at this price. 106 m² with two bedrooms plus a storage room and a living, dining and kitchen space of over 20 tatami, on a 1,181 m² freehold plot in Ago-cho Tategami, in the Ise-Shima area of Mie. The advert lists the sea within 2 km, mountain views, a supermarket within a 10 minute walk and parking for three or more cars. Water comes from a well and there is a septic tank. Asking ¥14,800,000 (about €84,500), roughly €800/m².

homes.title: Mt. Fuji cabin with sauna deck, cold plunge and a guest cabin
homes.title_es: Cabaña en el monte Fuji con terraza para sauna, baño de agua fría y cabaña de invitados
homes.summary: A cabin at the foot of Mt. Fuji with a deck built for sauna nights, for $48,000. It sits in a quiet highland cabin community in Fujikawaguchiko, Yamanashi, with cool summers, real winters and Mt. Fuji on the other side of the trees.
